ValidationRule.description: Ensures asset allocation percentages total 100% when all three are populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Asset_Allocation_Stocks__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Asset_Allocation_Bonds__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Asset_Allocation_Cash__c)), (Asset_Allocation_Stocks__c + Asset_Allocation_Bonds__c + Asset_Allocation_Cash__c) <> 1.0 )
